name: Assumption-Ledger Elicitation
description: Before a long-horizon plan runs, enumerate what it silently assumes, rate each row high/medium/low, and treat a LOW-confidence LOAD-BEARING row as a verify-or-clarify trigger rather than a silent bet. A required-but-blank field defaults to the WORST case and that default is written down. On any step failure the ledger is re-read first, because a wrong assumption is the usual root cause.

plan_path.description: The plan whose assumptions are extracted

required_fields.description: Fields the plan MUST fill; a blank one is adverse-inferred to worst case

worst_case_defaults.description: field -> the worst-case value a blank must resolve to

probe_budget.description: Max verification probes fanned out for LOW+load-bearing rows

extractor.description: Reads the plan and lists what it takes for granted, including omissions

rater.description: Assigns load_bearing and a high/medium/low band, and must justify a high band

prober.description: Re-derives a low-confidence assumption in a fresh context that cannot inherit the plan's reasoning

routes.reason: a same-vendor prober inherits the same blind spot that produced the assumption

stages.title: S0 EXTRACT the assumptions the plan rests on

work_unit.title: Extract the load-bearing premises a plan never states
work_unit.question_or_target: List every premise the plan would break without, including premises implied by an omission.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: each row quotes the plan line that implies it, or names the omission that implies it
tests_required: a plan with a blank required field must yield a row carrying the worst-case default
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the rater, who may not also author rows
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-REQ04-S0 only when every row quotes a plan line or names the omission it comes from; otherwise FAILED:BP3-REQ04-S0 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a differently-seeded extraction

stages.title: S0b APPLY the adverse-inference default to every blank required field
S1 MARK which rows are load-bearing

work_unit.title: Mark load_bearing, and drop rows that are not
work_unit.question_or_target: Decide, per row, whether the plan fails if the row is false. A non-load-bearing row is deleted, not carried.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: judgement, reviewed by the prober downstream

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each load_bearing=true row names the plan step that fails if the row is false
tests_required: a ritual row with no failing step must be dropped, keeping the ledger from becoming a checklist
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the prober re-reads the marks before probing
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-REQ04-S1 only when no row is load_bearing without a named failing step; otherwise FAILED:BP3-REQ04-S1 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot; a third identical marking pass is banned

work_unit.title: Attach a calibrated band to every load-bearing row
work_unit.question_or_target: Assign high, medium or low to each load-bearing row and pair the band with its evidence tag.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: calibrated banding, not a bare hedge

work_unit.evidence_requirement: a high band cites the measurement that justifies it; a bare 'should be fine' is rejected as a hedge
tests_required: a high band with no cited measurement must be demoted to low
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-REQ04-S2 only when every band is paired with an evidence tag; otherwise FAILED:BP3-REQ04-S2 <reason>

stages.title: S3 VERIFY every LOW-confidence load-bearing row (never silently bet)

work_unit.title: Re-derive one low-confidence assumption in a fresh context
work_unit.question_or_target: Independently establish or refute one assumption using a mechanically different measurement from the one that produced it.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor so the probe cannot inherit the author's reasoning

work_unit.evidence_requirement: names BOTH the source measurement that produced the assumption and the mechanically different one that checked it
tests_required: re-running the ORIGINAL probe must be rejected as a non-independent signal
a probe with no declared source measurement is a violation, not an independent confirmation
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the rater reads the probe before the band is revised
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-REQ04-S3 only when the artifact names a source probe AND a mechanically different verifier; otherwise FAILED:BP3-REQ04-S3 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a third measurement class

stages.title: S3 gate: no LOW+load-bearing row may be carried silently
S4 RE-CHECK the ledger on any step failure (failure-triggered, not scheduled)

work_unit.title: Find which ledger row the failure falsifies
work_unit.question_or_target: Map the observed failure back to the assumption it falsifies, or state that no ledger row explains it.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: links the failure signal to the row it falsifies, or records NO-LEDGER-ROW-EXPLAINS-THIS
tests_required: a failure explained by no row must widen the ledger, not be forced onto an existing row
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the rater, who must accept or contest the demotion before it lands
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-REQ04-S4D only when the failure is either linked to a row or explicitly recorded as unexplained; otherwise FAILED:BP3-REQ04-S4D <reason>

impact.blast_radius: read-only over the plan and repo; writes only under command-center/assumptions/**

x_extensions.distinguishing_mechanism: route a LOW-confidence load-bearing row to a cross-vendor VERIFICATION PROBE, not to an owner question; and resolve a blank required field to the worst case. BP-REQ-03 asks the owner; this one interrogates the world.

worked_example.name: stale pinned ref plus a blank required field
worked_example.narrative: A plan assumes 'origin/main is at the ref we pinned three weeks ago' and leaves the rollback field blank. The pinned-ref row is load-bearing with low confidence and no probe, so it must be reported unhandled. The blank rollback field must resolve to the declared worst case, not to an empty string.

rows.text: origin/main is still at the ref pinned three weeks ago
the test suite runs in under ten minutes
the coverage gate command exists in this project

unhandled_texts: origin/main is still at the ref pinned three weeks ago

controls.mutate: give the pinned-ref row a verification_probe
controls.why: a probed row is handled; the gate must then pass
